# Duties
Office staff without an assigned task are to work at the Company work terminals. All terminal earnings go into the corporate budget.
## General - Staff should rotate between terminals. Repeating the same task pays less each time, and auditors notice. - Tasks assigned by the Liaison take priority over terminal work. - Terminals may only be used for Company business.
## Records and Audit - Check the site's ledger against its receipts and flag every entry that doesn't match. - Report any pattern of irregularities to the Liaison.
## Logistics - Plan the freight manifest for outbound shuttles. - A manifest may not exceed the shuttle's weight, volume or hazard limits. Overloaded manifests are rejected by the shuttle crew.
## Secure Transmissions - Decode intercepted radio traffic by recovering its cipher key. - Decoded traffic is Company property and may not be discussed outside the office.
## Corporate Markets - Staff may trade goods and commodities on the Company's account from a Company terminal. - The Company newswire reports market news before the market reacts. Staff should check it before trading. - Large orders move the price. The last units of a large purchase cost more than the first. - Every trade is charged a 2% brokerage fee. Company holdings pay a small dividend every minute. - The site may hold no more than $10,000 in goods at any time. - Staff may not trade on their own behalf from a Company terminal. Personal trading is to be done from a personal desktop.
## Reporting - Significant events must be reported to the Liaison as soon as possible. - Losses are to be reported promptly. Successes are to be reported immediately.
